set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- Axes construction normalizes negative axes once, rejects duplicates, and records a deterministic order.
- The selected reductions have coherent multi-axis and keepDims semantics.
- Implementations plan the full reduction once rather than allocating sequential intermediate arrays.
- Floating merge order is specified directly rather than emerging from repeated one-axis calls.
- Empty axes, empty dimensions, NaN, signed zero, overflow, and invalid axes have JVM and Scala.js tests.
- Multidimensional argMin or argMax semantics are either specified or explicitly deferred.
set.title: Plan multi-axis reductions through a validated Axes value
